cgv.title: General terms of sale
cgv.intro:
These General Terms of Sale apply to the paid services offered on ForTheSoul.ch, including the publication of experiences, the promotion of offers and the publication of venues.

The arrangements, prices, duration and conditions applicable to each service are stated at the time of ordering.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.text: These General Terms of Sale define the conditions applicable to the purchase of paid services offered on ForTheSoul.ch.

sections.title: Prices and payment
sections.text:
Prices are stated in Swiss francs (CHF) or euros depending on the selected currency and correspond to the rates displayed at the time of ordering.

Payment is made through the payment provider offered at checkout.

The order is considered final once payment has been confirmed.

sections.title: Use of services
sections.text:
Paid services may be used according to the arrangements stated at the time of ordering.

Depending on the service selected, it may allow content to be published, kept online, featured or promoted on ForTheSoul.ch.

The conditions applicable to a service are those stated when it is purchased.

sections.title: Publication and review of content
sections.text:
Purchasing a paid service does not guarantee that content will be accepted or published.

ForTheSoul reserves the right to refuse, modify or remove content that does not comply with the General Terms of Use, the platform rules or applicable legal provisions.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
sections.text:
Once a paid service has been used or an offer has been published, no refund is granted when the practitioner, organiser or venue owner changes their mind or simply wishes to cancel the publication.

No refund is granted when published content is subsequently modified by its author and no longer complies with the General Terms of Use.

No refund is granted if an event, experience or offer is cancelled by the practitioner, organiser or venue owner.

If ForTheSoul refuses to publish an offer because it does not comply with the General Terms of Use, and that non-compliance already existed when the offer was submitted, the amount paid for the relevant service is refunded.

No refund is due when the non-compliance results from a change made by the user after publication or activation of the service.

sections.title: Changes to prices and services
sections.text:
ForTheSoul may change its prices, services and their conditions for future orders.

These changes do not affect services already purchased, unless otherwise required by law.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: Any question concerning a purchase or these General Terms of Sale may be submitted through the Contact page on ForTheSoul.ch.

items.a: A Swiss platform of conscious experiences — dance, meditation, yoga, sound journeys, retreats — hand-picked one by one by Didier Picamoles. No algorithm, just real encounters.
Every practitioner and every experience is personally reviewed by Didier before publication.

items.q: How do I join an experience ?
items.a: Browse the catalogue, open the listing that speaks to you and follow the instructions to contact the practitioner or book. Save your favourites.
Not to explore and save favourites (tied to your device). An account is only needed for practitioners who want to publish.

items.q: I'm a practitioner, how do I publish ?
items.a: Create a practitioner account, complete your profile (reviewed by Didier), then submit your experiences. Each publication uses one credit.

items.q: How much does it cost to publish a profile and events on ForTheSoul?
items.a: Creating an account and publishing a profile are free. Publishing events is paid. Prices are shown directly in your personal space, from your dashboard.
Credit packs needed to publish events can be purchased directly from your personal space. Payment can be made by credit card or TWINT, via Stripe.

items.q: Can I use ForTheSoul for free?

about.title: The ForTheSoul story
about.metaDescription: ForTheSoul was born from Didier Picamoles' conviction: transformative experiences are chosen with the heart, not by an algorithm.
about.p1: ForTheSoul was born from a need: to bring together in one place those who offer experiences, those who seek authentic experiences that nourish the soul, and those who offer places to host them.
about.p2: The goal is to make connections between these three worlds easier and to grow a true Swiss community — with the possibility of offering experiences and events abroad as well.
about.p3: Creator of the Humanic Dance and immersive experiences, Didier has met, danced and shared many experiences with the people on this platform, as co-creator, dancer or participant.
about.p4: This is also what makes ForTheSoul unique: every practitioner and every experience is personally reviewed. A slower, more demanding choice — but one that puts quality before quantity.
about.p5: Retreats, ecstatic dance, meditation, sound journeys, circles, immersive experiences in Switzerland or abroad: ForTheSoul gathers offerings that invite you to slow down, feel, explore and return to what truly matters.
about.thanks: Thank you for supporting ForTheSoul with your presence, your experiences or your place.
about.quote: I wish for you to live the same magnificent experiences as those I have lived.
